items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: Oh, yeah. It's Lanko. Oh, I know.

ctx.x: Yes, I'd like to see those sometime.

You'll see them. Next time you all come, I'll get them for them. I was hoping you would maybe play a little tune for us before we went out on. You went. I thought maybe you'd play us a little tune this morning, on Ukraine. Oh, yeah. It's Lanko. Oh, I know. Some other time. Some other time. Do you still play on Sunday evenings? Yes. Yes. Yes. Yes. Oh, maybe I'll come around here. Come on here. And you have it. About what time is the best time? Oh, we start at 8.30. Yes, sir?
One thing I wanted to ask too was this. Uh, is there anything that you have had in your mind that you would like to record, that you have never recorded, that you never had an opportunity to do?
